compounds.name: acetic acid

ammonia.reason: Limited amino-acid deamination by wild LAB, no surface mold, pH stays ~5.3 at 60d.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw Merino ewe milk with pasture-derived p-cresol/indole and enterococci metabolism.

bitter.reason: Excess hydrophobic peptides from Cynara cardunculus cardosin A/B aspartic proteases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no blue-mold methyl-ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and sheep-milk protein during heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from citrate fermentation by wild Lactococcus/Leuconostoc in raw milk.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butyric 71-169 mg/kg plus caproic lipolysis by raw-milk lipase and cardoon coagulant.

creaminess.reason: Uncooked curd 42.6% moisture plus extensive cardosin proteolysis gives spoonable paste.

crumbliness.reason: Highly proteolyzed, high-moisture matrix flows rather than fractures.

firmness.reason: Softened by 60d proteolysis and retained moisture, 1-kg flattened format sags.

floral_honey.reason: Pasture terpenes transferred to Merino milk plus phenylacetaldehyde from Strecker.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/decanoate from esterification of liberated FFA by yeasts/wild LAB.

goaty.reason: Sheep-milk caproic 51-93 mg/kg and caprylic 87-189 mg/kg released by lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker aldehydes 2/3-methylbutanal from short 60d ripening, no cooked-curd propionibacteria.

melt.reason: pH 5.34 demineralized para-casein with high moisture and fat flows on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: C8 alcohols from linoleic acid lipoxygenase and wild yeast metabolism.

oil_off.reason: Free sheep-milk fat released by extensive lipolysis total FFA 2500-3370 mg/kg at 4 mo.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol-producing process.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 682-1144 mg/kg from heterofermentative wild LAB with no starter.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, rennet gel does not align into fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Raw milk, no curd cooking, minimal methionine catabolism to methanethiol/DMS.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted by 60d, slight sweetness from proline and sheep-milk fat glycerol.

umami.reason: Glutamate and savory peptides from cardosin plus plasmin proteolysis of ewe casein.
